treasury_new_category_description: Categories group transactions, for example "Landscaping" or "Donations".
treasury_category_activated_description: {name} is available again when recording transactions
treasury_category_deactivated_descriptio: {name} will no longer appear when recording transactions
treasury_category_kind_locked: The type can't be changed once created.
treasury_category_name_description: How it will appear in the transactions list.
treasury_system_category_description: {source} uses this category. You can rename it, but you can't deactivate or delete it.
treasury_delete_category_description: It has no recorded transactions, so it will be deleted permanently. This action can't be undone.
treasury_record_transaction_description: Any income or expense that isn't a maintenance fee. Fees are recorded with "Record fee".
treasury_system_transaction_description: Here you can only correct the receipt number, payment method, reference and notes. To change anything else, delete the transaction and record it again from {source}.
treasury_transfer_reference_description: Bank tracking key or reference number.
treasury_house_description: Optional. If the money comes from a specific house.
treasury_transaction_notes_description: Optional. Vendor, agreements, or any remarks.
treasury_search_transactions_hint: Search by description, receipt number, reference, category or house

match.countPlural=one: It will no longer count toward the balance ({impact}).
match.countPlural=other: They will no longer count toward the balance ({impact}).

treasury_delete_fee_clause_one: It's a fee, so that month will show as pending again for the house.
treasury_delete_fee_clause_many: It includes fees, so those months will show as pending again for their houses.
treasury_delete_amenity_clause: The reservation will show as pending payment again.
treasury_delete_undo_hint: You'll only be able to undo it for a few seconds.
treasury_record_fee_description: One receipt per house. If they pay several months, select them all; the late fee is charged for each month paid after the due day.

match.countPlural=one: 1 month is paid after day {dueDay}. Turn this on if the HOA board waived the late fee.
match.countPlural=other: {count} months are paid after day {dueDay}. Turn this on if the HOA board waived the late fee.

treasury_fee_notes_description: Optional. Who paid, agreements, or any remarks.
treasury_no_period_description: No period covers the payment date. Create the period before recording fees.
treasury_reference_required: The reference is required for transfers
treasury_monthly_fee_positive: The fee must be greater than zero
treasury_late_fee_negative: The late fee can't be negative
treasury_error_fee_month_taken: That house already has the fee recorded for one of the selected months
treasury_error_fee_months_taken: That house already has the fee recorded for {months}
treasury_error_reservation_paid: That reservation already has its payment recorded
treasury_error_category_name_taken: A category with that name already exists
treasury_error_period_name_taken: A period with that name already exists
treasury_error_system_category: Transactions in that category are recorded from {source}
treasury_error_no_period: No period covers that date. Create the period first.
treasury_error_house_gone: The selected house no longer exists
